mechanism: Lock one original carrier, one route direction and one forward-tracking relationship before any transformation. Use one causally triggered boundary breach to convert the surrounding material world while the carrier's identity, heading and motion remain continuous. Preserve a readable destination through the new geography and end on an explicit arrival action followed by a stable hold. The reusable mechanism is route continuity through world conversion and terminal arrival, not the source seabird, tiled wall, ocean vortex, lighthouse, sunset, exact flight path, watermark or prompt wording.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable carrier, route direction and camera relationship before the boundary changes.
invariants.purpose: Creates a continuity baseline that survives the world conversion.
invariants.ablation_failure: Beginning inside the transformed world makes the transition unprovable.

invariants.rule: Use one visible boundary event that causally opens the new material environment.
invariants.purpose: Connects the two worlds through an attributable action.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated cut becomes ordinary montage.

invariants.rule: Keep carrier identity, heading and forward progress continuous through the turbulent middle state.
invariants.purpose: Prevents the transformation from replacing the subject or route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Direction reversal or identity drift breaks the travel logic.

invariants.rule: Reveal and preserve one destination after the new world becomes readable.
invariants.purpose: Gives the converted route a concrete objective.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing landmarks every shot creates spectacle without navigation.

invariants.rule: End with one explicit arrival action and a held terminal state.
invariants.purpose: Proves the route completed rather than merely continuing.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending mid-flight leaves the mechanism open.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source white seabird, feathers, anatomy, flight poses and exact identity
the source off-white tiled wall, crack pattern, flying white shards and paper-like fragments
the source blue ocean vortex, lighthouse, rocks, sunset, lantern gallery and exact destination composition
the source shot timing, route, camera orbit, landing choreography and warm-cool grade
the source churvikv and DreaminaAI watermark, model labels and creator prompt wording
